name: Sonbahar Yaprakları
scene: A hedgehog with sweeping amber and sienna quills walks among autumn foliage in an oval stained-glass panel.
notes: Design sheet only. Target 31–41 panes. Generated and visually inspected twice; second image selected for its opaque white exterior and simplified background.
